summary.headline: YAS signs KRW 12.4bn display evaporation source supply deal with China Star unit
summary.what_happened: YAS Co., Ltd filed a corrected disclosure for a single supply contract to supply evaporation sources for display mass production to Guangzhou China Star Optoelectronics Printing Display Technology Co., Ltd in China. The correction changed the contract period end date from Nov 30, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 due to a change in the delivery date. The contract was signed on Jun 12, 2026, with a fixed contract amount of KRW 12.42bn, equal to 35.74% of the company's recent revenue.

key_numbers.label: Payment terms
key_numbers.value: 90% interim payment (L/C after FOB); 10% balance (T/T after acceptance test)

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, filings of single large supply contracts generally indicate a new order relative to a company's revenue scale, and corrections to contract terms such as delivery or period dates typically reflect timing adjustments agreed between the parties. Such disclosures give shareholders information on order flow, though actual revenue recognition depends on contract execution.
